name: Demiurge
introduce:
HRX-112VE 弥造者
以海莉丝的设计为基础，经地平线公司、防卫军先进武器研究院先后开发，由维斯珀尔最终完成的中型机兵，也是世界上第一部真正的第四世代机兵。
该机装备了两组新式岚物质自循环引擎，且与全身钢岚合金框架直接链接，不仅可以提供强大的出力，还可通过施加精确的电磁影响，即时控制各处的岚粒子压缩与释放，使得该机在维持较轻重量的同时拥有远超常规的机械强度。此外，全新设计的通用武装接口使得该机不仅可以兼容多型常规武装，还可在特定条件下将岚粒子高效应用于战斗之中。这一系列先进但又过于复杂的机体设计带来了极大的不稳定性，曾一度被认为无法投入实用，但在海莉丝借助「遗产」之力完成了「真知系统」与「帕姆斯阵列」统筹其系统运作之后，HRX-112VE弥造者真正成为了维斯珀尔撼动局势的最终兵器。

20654.name: True Knowledge System
20654.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>20%</color>. If the current weapon is different than the previous one, DMG dealt additionally increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color>.

30548.name: All Creation Module
30548.SpecificEffects:
For each <color=#F74848>1</color> different profession on the team, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>6%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>24%</color>.
If there are <color=#F74848>4</color> or more professions on the team, Initial AP <color=#F74848>+1</color>, AP recovery <color=#F74848>+1</color>. Enters the <buf ID=900121>[Restriction Removal]</buf> state, activating the extra module effect integrated within the part.

hiddenModules.name: Universal Singularity
hiddenModules.SpecificEffects: Removes restrictions, enhances all forms: Vanguard: Critical Hit chance and Critical Hit DMG increase by 10%. Assault: Assault weapon bullet count +1. Tactical: Hit Rate increases by 3% for every 1 AP consumed when using tactical weapons, up to 15%. [Virtual Particle Form]: AP consumption reduces by -1, Final DMG dealt increases by 15%, movement increases by +1. Only [Hailis] can activate this module.
